releaseNotes: feat: Add dynamic color support and clipboard parsing for panel credentials
changelog: Implemented dynamic color feature in MainActivity and related ViewModel.
Added clipboard parsing functionality to extract panel URL and API token.
Enhanced AppearanceScreen to include dynamic color toggle.
Updated AboutScreen with animated hero card and OTA highlight feature.
Introduced server shortcuts for quick access to online servers.
Added unit tests for clipboard parsing and server shortcut selection logic.
Updated Arabic and English string resources for new features.
